title: lhsdesign

gpu_support.notes: Latin hypercube designs are generated on the host from RunMat's global random stream.

description: `lhsdesign(n,p)` returns an `n`-by-`p` Latin hypercube design with one sample in each stratum of every column.
behaviors: `n` and `p` must be positive integer-valued single or double scalars in MATLAB-compatible mode; native typed-integer dimensions are a RunMat extension and decode exactly.
`"Smooth","on"` jitters points uniformly within each stratum. `"Smooth","off"` places points at stratum midpoints.
`"Criterion"` supports `"maximin"`, `"correlation"`, and `"none"`; the correlation criterion uses midpoint strata, matching MATLAB's discrete correlation-optimized design behavior.
`"Iterations",k` generates multiple candidate designs for optimized criteria and keeps the best scored candidate.
The result uses column-major `n`-by-`p` shape and values in the open interval `(0,1)`.
Native typed-integer Iterations and Smooth controls are separately gated RunMat extensions.
Interactive gpuArray input is a RunMat-only host-fallback extension. Automatic internal residency may gather transparently without changing compatibility admission.

faqs.question: Does lhsdesign use RunMat's rng state?
faqs.answer: Yes. It consumes values from the same global random stream as rand, datasample, and randsample.
